release_summary: Cherry's Chat 0.11.0 sends emoji in Say as :code: text (or game-font symbols) so the bubble over your head shows them instead of empty boxes; the game draws bubbles itself, so pictures can't go in them. Everything else from 0.11.101 is included unchanged.
runtime_validation: Lua 5.1 simulated-client suite: 925 tests; 899 passed and 26 retired-editor tests skipped. New tests cover CherrysClock, the daily reset in five time zones and across Germany's clock changes, the local host's time file, Cherry's Loginxml's addon and installer, LogNextChar, the CurseForge pages, and each addon installed with only the hub, compared with the full kit on a stand-in client. Chrome's side ran end to end on real Chrome 155 with a test profile: setup opened the extensions page, filled in the folder and loaded the extension, which wrote the time file, and a Chrome start wrote it again. Nothing new has run in the game yet: docs/TESTING.md lists the checks. Unchanged addon packages keep their versions and byte-identical files.
